topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just can't believe this is happening. Everything was going so smoothly, and now here I am, stuck at the airport because of a delay. I've watched the clock tick by, each minute feeling longer than the last. I had this event circled on my calendar for weeks, and now it's slipping through my fingers. It seems like all the preparation, all the anticipation, was for nothing. I keep looking at my phone, hoping for a miracle update that will get me there on time, but the reality is setting in. It's a hard pill to swallow, realizing that some things are just beyond my control.
